verdicts.reason: A breaks the original reading order by moving the SOLSTICE logo to the right above the CTA, jams the headline against the left edge with almost no margin, leaves a large gap between the headline and its subcopy, and leaves the middle of the canvas empty. B keeps the original logo, headline, CTA order with sensible margins and grouping. Its flaws: the headline and subcopy are undersized for the taller 768x192 canvas (the subcopy is barely readable), the headline-to-subcopy gap is loose, and the band reads as a stretched leaderboard rather than a layout recomposed for the new shape.
